segments.t: See how great a love
segments.note: 「great a」は ποταπὴν（どんなに大きな）のほぐし

segments.t: the Father has given to us,
that we should be called children of God!
segments.note: 主語の「we」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: For this cause the world doesn’t know us,
segments.note: καὶ ἐσμέν（12,13番「そして私たちはそうである」）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: because it didn’t know him.
segments.note: 主語の「it」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: Beloved, now we are children of God.
It is not yet revealed what we will be;
segments.note: 「It」は英語の補い

segments.t: but we know that when he is revealed,
segments.note: 主語の「he」は φανερωθῇ に含まれる

segments.t: we will be like him,
for we will see him just as he is.
Everyone who has this hope set on him
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。「set」は ἐπ’ の表出

segments.t: purifies himself,
even as he is pure.
Everyone who sins
also commits lawlessness.
Sin is lawlessness.
segments.note: καὶ（10番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: You know that he was revealed
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。主語の「You」は動詞に含まれる

segments.t: to take away
our
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「our」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: sins,
and no sin is in him.
Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin.
Whoever sins hasn’t seen him
and doesn’t know him.
Little children, let no one lead you astray.
segments.note: 「let」は英語の補い

segments.t: He who does righteousness is righteous,
even as he is righteous.
He who sins is of the devil,
for the devil has been sinning from the beginning.
segments.note: ἁμαρτάνει（罪を犯し続ける）を現在進行形で訳す

segments.t: To this end the Son of God was revealed:
segments.note: 「end」は εἰς τοῦτο の補い

segments.t: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
segments.note: 主語の「he」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: Whoever is born of God
doesn’t commit sin,
because his seed remains in him,
and he can’t sin,
segments.note: 主語の「he」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: because he is born of God.
segments.note: 主語の「he」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: In this the children of God are revealed,
and the children of the devil.
Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God,
neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
segments.note: 繋辞「is he」は英語の補い

segments.t: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning,
that we should love one another—
unlike Cain,
who was of the evil one
segments.note: 関係詞は英語の補い

segments.t: and killed his brother.
Why did he kill him?
segments.note: καὶ（13番）は英語に現れないので対応なし。主語の「he」は動詞に含まれる

segments.t: Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
segments.note: 後半の「were」は英語の補い

segments.t: Don’t be surprised,
my
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「my」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: brothers,
if the world hates you.
We know that we have passed out of death into life,
because we love the brothers.
He who doesn’t love
his brother
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「his brother」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: remains in death.
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer,
segments.note: 不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
By this we know love,
because he laid down his life for us.
segments.note: 「laid down」は ἔθηκεν（置いた）の句動詞化

segments.t: And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
segments.note: 「our」は文脈からの補い（τὰς ψυχὰς は「いのち」）

segments.t: But whoever has the world’s goods
and sees his brother in need,
then closes his heart of compassion against him,
segments.note: τὰ σπλάγχνα（腸）を「heart of compassion」と訳す。「then」は英語の補い

segments.t: how does God’s love remain in him?
segments.note: 助動詞「does」は英語の補い

segments.t: My little children, let’s not love
segments.note: 「My」は英語の補い

segments.t: in word only,
segments.note: 「in」は与格の表出。「only」は英語の補い

segments.t: or with the tongue only,
segments.note: 「only」は英語の補い

segments.t: but in deed and truth.
And by this we know that we are of the truth
segments.note: 文頭の「And」は英語の補い

segments.t: and persuade our hearts before him,
because if our heart condemns us,
segments.note: 「us」は ἡμῶν が受ける目的語として補われる

segments.t: God is greater than our heart,
segments.note: ὅτι（7番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: and knows all things.
segments.note: 主語は前句の ὁ θεὸς

segments.t: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us,
segments.note: ἡ καρδία（単数）を WEB が複数「hearts」と訳す

segments.t: we have boldness toward God;
so whatever we ask,
segments.note: καὶ を「so」と訳す

segments.t: we receive from him,
because we keep his commandments
and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
segments.note: τὰ ἀρεστὰ（喜ばれる事柄）を「the things that are pleasing」とほぐす

segments.t: This is his commandment,
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ,
segments.note: 「in」は τῷ ὀνόματι の与格の表出

segments.t: and love one another,
even as he commanded.
segments.note: ἡμῖν（22番「私たちに」）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: He who keeps his commandments remains in him,
segments.note: καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: and he in him.
By this we know that he remains in us,
segments.note: καὶ（14番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: by the Spirit which he gave us.
segments.note: 主語の「he」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる
